notes: TBox expansion of physics-replace-0019 (mechanical waves and the vacuum): the same relation and new object (can cross a vacuum), given to a made-up kind of wave (threnic waves) placed under the real class of waves, which leaves the medium open (light and radio waves cross a vacuum, sound does not). The revision's class, mechanical waves, is not used: needing a medium is what defines a mechanical wave, so a mechanical wave that crosses a vacuum would override a held definition (overwriting) instead of filling an empty slot. Derived: a member named in the prompt (inheritance), the Sun to the Earth (whose near-empty space is stored), and whether a member needs a medium (no), so the answers are not all yes. The near query asks about sound, a real wave that needs a medium, whose answer a leak of the rule would change. Counts for the made-up names are zero by construction.
